nodes.name: Webhook: call.completed
nodes.notes: Point AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_URL (or AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_URL_CALL_COMPLETED) at this node's Production URL. The Header Auth credential must match AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_AUTH_HEADER / AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_AUTH_TOKEN. Answers 200 at once; the agent's deliverer retries on anything else.

nodes.name: Is a call result?
nodes.notes: Every delivery carries event_id; n8n re-runs are safe because the CRM writes below are keyed on the contact, not on the delivery. To de-duplicate strictly, keep event_id in a Data Table and skip ones already seen.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [ ...($json.email ? [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'email', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.email }] }] : []), { filters: [{ propertyName: 'phone', operator: 'CONTAINS_TOKEN', value: $json.phone.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-9) }] } ], properties: ['email', 'phone', 'firstname', 'lastname'], limit: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: find contact
nodes.notes: Email first, then the last nine digits of the number (a number stored as 0300 1234567 still matches +923001234567). Any CRM works here: replace the three HubSpot nodes with your CRM's find / update / create.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { ai_last_disposition: $('Flatten').first().json.disposition, ai_last_call_at: String($('Flatten').first().json.call_at_ms), ai_qualification: $('Flatten').first().json.qualification, ai_next_action: $('Flatten').first().json.next_action, ai_summary: $('Flatten').first().json.summary_text, ai_pain_points: $('Flatten').first().json.pain_points, hs_lead_status: $('Flatten').first().json.do_not_call ? 'UNQUALIFIED' : undefined } }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: update contact
nodes.notes: The ai_* properties are the ones Phase 15's `campaign.py crm-sync` creates on first run (or create them yourself under Settings → Properties). Delete any you do not have; HubSpot rejects unknown property names.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ properties: { firstname: $('Flatten').first().json.first_name, lastname: $('Flatten').first().json.last_name, phone: $('Flatten').first().json.phone, email: $('Flatten').first().json.email || undefined, company: $('Flatten').first().json.company || undefined, ai_last_disposition: $('Flatten').first().json.disposition, ai_last_call_at: String($('Flatten').first().json.call_at_ms), ai_qualification: $('Flatten').first().json.qualification, ai_next_action: $('Flatten').first().json.next_action, ai_summary: $('Flatten').first().json.summary_text } }) }}

nodes.name: HubSpot: add note
nodes.notes: 202 is HubSpot's note→contact association. The event_id is written into the note, so a duplicate delivery is visible and can be found.
